reviews.body: We thought the liner under neith was a bit weird so we cut it and made it a shorter dress. Didn’t even have to sew it because the material wasn’t the type to come apart

Ordered this for my daughter. We returned it because we didn’t see in the photos provided that the bottom of the dress is sheer below the knees - it just kind of looked weird. We thought it was a regular full length dress. Had there been a pic with it on a model, we’d have seen right away and not ordered.

Very pretty spaghetti strap dress for summer and spring! Love the large flowers, they look very modern and elegant. Vibrant colors on the flowers. The fabric is elastic and the dress fits me like a glove. It is light weight. The straps are adjustable. I like that there is inner layer, as the outer fabric is sheer. This is a great dress for daily wear with sandals, suitable for beach town vacation, picnic, shopping, sightseeing or casual party with friends. I think it can be dressed up with accessories for an evening summer occasion as well. I like the versatility very much, I can wear it as a comfortable house dress at the summer house. Good for many uses in my opinion.

I wear size 8 or medium in ladies US size. Medium fits me well, this dress is true to size. Very good value for the price. Very pleased!

I wore this for a church wedding. The photos online look fine, but I was pleasantly surprised with everything about this dress! It's a really nice dress! Firstly, it's super comfortable. It's easy to walk in, the chain halter isn't clunky or heavy, it's well made but still light enough for Florida (but like, indoors Florida). It's great quality, doesn't feel cheap at all. I think it was worth the price. It was shipped SO WELL like it was on a hanger in a dress sleeve, something I'm not used to from the Amazon dresses shoved in a zip bag. It fit true to size (34-27-37). The bust is padded and even though it was a bit roomy, the padding made a very flattering shape (read as: makes you look like you have big boobs whether you do or not). The v cut is conservative and doesn't show any cleavage. The back is nice, nothing special. The length is more formal than casual, which was fine for my occasion. Overall, I'm very pleased. There are so many basic halter satin dresses out there but this one is so unique because of the chain and subtly colored pattern. I added a matching gold belt to complete the look!
The fabric was really pretty and I loved the bottom half, but their were built in cups that were placed too high for my chest for the top to sit naturally without tape or divine intervention.
Beautiful dress , great quality , must buy

I wore this dress for Valentine’s Day dinner with my boyfriend and it was absolutely perfect! The fit is so flattering and hugs in all the right places without feeling uncomfortable. The material feels smooth and high quality, and it has just the right amount of stretch to make it easy to move and sit comfortably all night. I’m 5”3 and 165 pounds for reference.

The polka dot design gives it such a timeless, elegant look — classy but still fun and feminine. I paired it with simple black heels and minimal jewelry, and it looked so put together.

If you’re looking for a dress that’s sophisticated, flattering, and perfect for a special date night or event, this is it. I felt confident, elegant, and beautiful all night. Highly recommend! 💕

Absolutely beautiful dress! One of the most beautiful dresses I own to date!
I also bought the purple one as well because I got tons of compliments on this one!
The blue colors are so amazing they pop! They brought out the color of my eyes! It’s extremely comfortable and the fabric gives a lot!!
And what I like most about it is that the scrunched up fabric or the crutched look, hides a lot of flaws lol. It really slims you out and doesn’t show any indentations from your bra and panties. The crutched material hides everything! For reference, I am 5’4 and 149 pounds, 40 DDD bra size, hope this helps when ordering!
By the way, the price is absolutely worth it!

This skin-tight dress is an absolute stunner! I chose the blue and green color combo, and it’s even more gorgeous in person. It fits like a glove and is incredibly flattering—hugging all the right places while still feeling comfortable to wear.

The material is high quality, with a soft, silky lining on the inside and a sheer mesh overlay that gives it a really elegant finish. I wore spandex underneath just for a bit of extra shaping, but honestly, it wasn’t even necessary—the dress looks amazing on its own.

It’s a longer style that falls to mid-calf, which adds to the sophisticated vibe. I think you could pair it with just about any jewelry—gold, silver, or even statement pieces—and I’m planning to wear it with nude heels for a polished look.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a sleek, stylish dress that feels as good as it looks!

I absolutely love this satin slip dress. The spaghetti straps and cowl neck give it such a flattering, elegant look, and the pink color is even more beautiful in person. The satin has a soft, silky feel and drapes perfectly, making it incredibly comfortable to wear while still looking polished and classy.
I wore this as a wedding guest dress and got so many compliments throughout the night. The midi length is just right, and the fit is very flattering without being too tight. It moves beautifully and photographs really well, too. This dress feels far more expensive than it is and exceeded all of my expectations.
If you’re looking for a chic, feminine dress for a wedding or any special event, this is an amazing choice. Five stars for sure.

Got this for a birthday dinner and it was absolutely perfect. It's a great fit. Little to no stretch. Flaunts your shape in a classy way. Nice heavy fabric that flows well and its well made also. This is the best dress I've bought on here and I'll definitely get more colors for other occasions.
Wore this for a wedding & it was perfect! Fit perfectly. I’m small chested so wore it with no bra & some small nipple covers. Very comfy & looked nice! 5 foot 7, athletic build, 140lbs
